items.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022
items.q: you know Marsalis is marvelous about doing this, you know going back to its roots

ctx.x: And it’s something to write about. Would you take that on?

I don’t know. I would be 51 percent no, 49 percent maybe. And I’ll tell you why. There has been a lot written about that, a lot discussed about that, it is a philosophical question. It’s a question that plays directly into jazz education. It’s a question that plays into access to technology. It is a very, very, very deep question that quite frankly I would say I don’t care to debate it, all I know is that it is a perennial art form that is a Black-American and American art form that is still evolving.
